data.name: Aday
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew and Greek, Aday translates to 'first light' or 'dawn.' In the Bible, the name Aday is not explicitly mentioned but can be linked to Adam, which means 'man' or 'earth.' The first man, Adam, was created at dawn, symbolizing the beginning of life.
